_comment: Catalogue of models PicAnnotate knows how to drive. This is data, not code:
adding a model is an entry here, not a new class.
Most entries have no 'url'. These models are published as PyTorch checkpoints
with no canonical ONNX build to link to, so each carries a 'sourceHint' with the
one command that produces the exact file instead. Once you have a URL and a
SHA-256 you trust, add them in the Model Manager and the app will download and
Fields: id, displayName, description, task, runtime, fileName, url, sha256,
bytes, sourceHint, inputWidth, inputHeight, labelSet, companion, license,

models.description: Smallest YOLOv8 detector. Fast enough to run on every frame of a video on CPU; the least accurate of the family.
models.sourceHint:
pip install ultralytics
yolo export model=yolov8n.pt format=onnx opset=12 imgsz=640 simplify=True

models.description: Small YOLOv8 detector. A good default when accuracy matters more than throughput.
models.sourceHint:
pip install ultralytics
yolo export model=yolov8s.pt format=onnx opset=12 imgsz=640 simplify=True

models.description: Medium YOLOv8 detector. Noticeably slower on CPU; worth it for a one-off batch pass over a dataset.
models.sourceHint:
pip install ultralytics
yolo export model=yolov8m.pt format=onnx opset=12 imgsz=640 simplify=True

models.description: Latest-generation nano detector. Same output layout as YOLOv8, slightly better accuracy at the same speed.
models.sourceHint:
pip install ultralytics
yolo export model=yolo11n.pt format=onnx opset=12 imgsz=640 simplify=True

models.description: Nano detector with an instance-mask head. Produces polygons directly, without needing SAM.
models.sourceHint:
pip install ultralytics
yolo export model=yolov8n-seg.pt format=onnx opset=12 imgsz=640 simplify=True

models.description: Small segmentation model. Cleaner mask boundaries than the nano variant.
models.sourceHint:
pip install ultralytics
yolo export model=yolov8s-seg.pt format=onnx opset=12 imgsz=640 simplify=True

models.description: Latest-generation nano segmentation model. Same output layout as YOLOv8-seg.
models.sourceHint:
pip install ultralytics
yolo export model=yolo11n-seg.pt format=onnx opset=12 imgsz=640 simplify=True

models.description: Distilled SAM backbone, roughly 40 MB. Encodes a frame in about a second on CPU, which is what makes click-to-segment usable without a GPU.
models.sourceHint:
pip install samexporter
python -m samexporter.export_encoder --checkpoint mobile_sam.pt --output mobile-sam-encoder.onnx --model-type vit_t

See docs/AI_SETUP.md § SAM for the full walkthrough.

models.description: Prompt decoder for MobileSAM. Tiny and fast: this is the part that re-runs on every click.
models.sourceHint:
pip install samexporter
python -m samexporter.export_decoder --checkpoint mobile_sam.pt --output mobile-sam-decoder.onnx --model-type vit_t --return-single-mask

See docs/AI_SETUP.md § SAM for the full walkthrough.

models.description: Meta's original SAM backbone. Sharper boundaries than MobileSAM at several times the cost — expect seconds per frame on CPU.
models.sourceHint:
pip install samexporter
python -m samexporter.export_encoder --checkpoint sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth --output sam-vit-b-encoder.onnx --model-type vit_b

See docs/AI_SETUP.md § SAM for the full walkthrough.

models.description: Prompt decoder for SAM ViT-B. Must come from the same export as its encoder — mixing decoders across variants produces plausible-looking nonsense rather than an error.
models.sourceHint:
pip install samexporter
python -m samexporter.export_decoder --checkpoint sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth --output sam-vit-b-decoder.onnx --model-type vit_b --return-single-mask

See docs/AI_SETUP.md § SAM for the full walkthrough.

models.description: Embeds a crop into CLIP's shared image/text space. Paired with the text encoder this classifies regions against your own class names, with no training.
models.sourceHint: See docs/AI_SETUP.md § CLIP — exports both towers from openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 with one script.

models.description: Embeds class names into the same space as the image encoder. Runs once per label schema change, then the embeddings are cached.
models.sourceHint: See docs/AI_SETUP.md § CLIP — exports both towers from openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 with one script.
